title: The impact of ESG performance on OFDI mode choice: the role of total factor productivity
core_idea: Develop a theoretical model and empirical test of how firms' ESG performance influences their outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) mode choice through effects on total factor productivity (TFP), and integrate ESG into classical OLI theory and the productivity threshold of new-new trade theory while examining heterogeneity across host-country ESG levels, bilateral investment agreements, industry sensitivity, and firms' intangible assets.
tldr: Model and empirically test whether and how firms' ESG performance affects their choice of OFDI mode via impacts on total factor productivity, integrating ESG into international investment theory and exploring heterogeneity and mechanisms using Chinese listed firm data.
